description: Links a chemical to a ZIP-code area where it was reported as an environmental release, detected in finished drinking water, or identified as a Superfund contaminant of concern.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this compound–location relationship.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the relationship was last updated.

source_contributions.scope: Industrial chemical releases within US ZIP-code areas; limited to chemicals and ZIP codes represented in SPOKE. Unresolved mixtures and multi-compound categories are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Release quantities are summed across reporting facilities within each ZIP code by environmental medium and unit for the reporting year. Source rows with zero total on-site releases are excluded. An edge can still have empty release arrays when none of the three retained media has a positive aggregated quantity.

properties.name: media
properties.description: Release medium: Air Emission, Surface Water Discharge, or Land Release; included only for positive aggregated quantities.
properties.notes: media[i], value[i], and unit[i] correspond to each other.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Aggregated release quantity for the corresponding medium and unit.
properties.notes: media[i], value[i], and unit[i] correspond to each other.

properties.name: unit
properties.description: Unit of the corresponding release quantity.
properties.notes: If a single (compound, ZIP) group has releases in multiple units for the same media type, each unit produces a separate entry (the same media label may appear more than once).

properties.name: year
properties.description: TRI reporting year of the release quantities.

source_contributions.scope: Finished drinking-water detections of monitored contaminants. Limited to compounds and ZIP-code areas represented in SPOKE; unresolved analytes are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Public water-system results are attributed to every ZIP code served by that system. Only exact, positive measurements are included; below-reporting-level and above-range results are excluded. Each compound–ZIP pair retains the maximum concentration, with the most recent collection date breaking ties.

properties.name: ucmr4_media
properties.description: Drinking Water.
properties.notes: ucmr4_media[i], ucmr4_value[i], ucmr4_unit[i], ucmr4_metrics[i], and ucmr4_date[i] are co-indexed; per the retention rule each holds exactly one element (index 0).

properties.name: ucmr4_value
properties.description: Highest measured concentration for the contaminant and ZIP-code area; ties use the most recent sample collection date.
properties.notes: ucmr4_media[i], ucmr4_value[i], ucmr4_unit[i], ucmr4_metrics[i], and ucmr4_date[i] are co-indexed; per the retention rule each holds exactly one element (index 0).

properties.name: ucmr4_unit
properties.description: Concentration unit: µg/L.
properties.notes: ucmr4_media[i], ucmr4_value[i], ucmr4_unit[i], ucmr4_metrics[i], and ucmr4_date[i] are co-indexed; per the retention rule each holds exactly one element (index 0).

properties.name: ucmr4_metrics
properties.description: MaximumConcentration(MRL) when the retained result has a Minimum Reporting Level (MRL); otherwise MaximumConcentration.
properties.notes: ucmr4_media[i], ucmr4_value[i], ucmr4_unit[i], ucmr4_metrics[i], and ucmr4_date[i] are co-indexed; per the retention rule each holds exactly one element (index 0).

properties.name: ucmr4_date
properties.description: Collection date of the retained sample.
properties.notes: YYYY-MM-DD; ucmr4_media[i], ucmr4_value[i], ucmr4_unit[i], ucmr4_metrics[i], and ucmr4_date[i] are co-indexed; per the retention rule each holds exactly one element (index 0).

properties.name: ucmr4_date_type
properties.description: Collection Date.

source_contributions.scope: Contaminants of concern at Superfund sites within US ZIP-code areas, recorded in EPA site decision documents and amendments. Limited to compounds and ZIP codes represented in SPOKE; unresolved contaminant labels are excluded. No NPL-status filtering is applied.
source_contributions.description: Records contaminant presence, environmental medium, site National Priorities List (NPL) status, and decision-document completion date. No measured concentration or quantity is provided. A compound–ZIP relationship may combine multiple sites and NPL statuses. Distinct media/status/date tuples are ordered by completion date, most recent first, with secondary ordering by media.

properties.name: superfund_media
properties.description: Environmental medium in which the contaminant was identified, such as Groundwater, Soil, or Sediment.
properties.notes: superfund_media[i], superfund_value[i], superfund_date[i], and superfund_metrics[i] all correspond to one another (one entry per distinct (media, NPL-status, completion-date) tuple for the pair). Parallel entry omitted if the tuple's media is null.

properties.name: superfund_value
properties.description: National Priorities List status of the site.
properties.notes: superfund_media[i], superfund_value[i], superfund_date[i], and superfund_metrics[i] all correspond to one another (one entry per distinct (media, NPL-status, completion-date) tuple for the pair).

properties.name: superfund_date
properties.description: Completion date of the associated site decision document.
properties.notes: superfund_media[i], superfund_value[i], superfund_date[i], and superfund_metrics[i] all correspond to one another (one entry per distinct (media, NPL-status, completion-date) tuple for the pair). YYYY-MM-DD; entry's date may be empty string if source date is missing.

properties.name: superfund_metrics
properties.description: NPL Status, describing the corresponding superfund_value entry.
properties.notes: superfund_media[i], superfund_value[i], superfund_date[i], and superfund_metrics[i] all correspond to one another (one entry per distinct (media, NPL-status, completion-date) tuple for the pair).

properties.name: superfund_date_type
properties.description: Actual Completion Date.
